sourceGuide.workflow: Assets only. Start with 10 verified picks per category. Every Sunday, replace up to five oldest picks with five new, useful assets. Keep existing picks if fewer replacements pass source, license and preview checks. Never repeat an asset across categories or reset its dates. Older assets remain in saved boards and Full collection. Match the selected project and hand off only the user-approved snapshot to Creative Partner.

selection.strategy: Use the selected project and verified reusable asset catalog. Prefer a small compatible set with actual previews. Keep publication dates separate from weekly picks. No inspiration posts.
selection.balance: Prefer original live demos, code, or a narrated walkthrough over announcements. Match type and feature, not follower count. Include at least two independent creators/publishers when possible.
selection.attribution: Credit the original maker and link the original artifact. Keep a curator post only as discovery context. Deduplicate the same work across X, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
selection.technicalClaims: Check current tool behavior against its own documentation. An influencer recommendation is not capability evidence.
selection.commercial: Keep sponsorship or creator-owned-product claims distinguishable from independent examples; do not automatically reject useful public demos.

platformAccess.YouTube: Use verified creator channels and public video pages. Record original publication date and useful timestamps. Use accessible captions/transcripts only; never invent the contents of an unseen video. Do not download videos.
platformAccess.Instagram: Use accessible original public Reels or carousels. If blocked, use a creator-owned article, YouTube walkthrough, or user-supplied link. No login automation or private feed coverage.
platformAccess.X: Use accessible original posts or approved APIs. Do not assume a recent-only search endpoint covers the full 90-day window.
platformAccess.LinkedIn: Use accessible original public posts. Search snippets can discover a post but do not establish full content, date, or media. No private feed coverage.
